Emergency Alert

Stopped sending at 11:06pm on Thursday 8 January 2026

Issued by the UK Government.

A RED warning for wind has been issued to large parts of Cornwall. Extremely strong winds are expected to cause significant disruption, with winds peaking from 6:00pm on Thursday 8 January 2026. Strong winds can present a danger to life. Stay indoors if you can and consider gathering torches and other essential items you already have at home.

Stay up to date with Met Office warnings and follow advice from emergency services, network operators and local authorities. For more information search online for gov.uk/alerts.
